scene.prompt:
Create one complete character image from the attached references. Use the character reference for identity and visual style, preserving the face, hairstyle, hair color, skin tone and body proportions. Use the pose reference only for gesture, balance and viewpoint, without mannequin lines or joints. Use the costume reference only for outfit, colors, garment shape and materials, without copying the outfit model's face or stance. Make clothing drape naturally with the pose. Keep the character fully clothed, with a simple background and no text, watermark, collage or comparison layout.
Reference 1 (pose): Use only the pose and single viewpoint shown in this image. Preserve head direction, shoulder and hip orientation, elbows, wrists, hand gestures, bent legs and occlusion. Do not move the hands behind the back unless shown. Match this image's framing. This is a depth map: brighter areas are closer to the camera. Use only its pose, perspective and occlusion; do not copy the grayscale, dark background or mannequin appearance.
Reference 2 (costume): Transfer only the visible garments, footwear and accessories, including design, colors, materials and placement, onto the same person. Do not copy the product arrangement, empty spacing or ghost-mannequin appearance.
Reference 3 (character): Preserve only this person's identity, facial features, face shape, hairstyle, hair color, skin tone and visual style. Do not copy this reference's pose, clothing or portrait crop, or add separate portraits or other views.
Final output: one continuous scene, one person and one selected viewpoint only. No panels, columns, storyboards, character sheets, inset close-ups, additional-angle images or repeated people. Combine all references into that one person.
